remarks: Welcome to 140 East Avenue a beautifully renovated home that seamlessly blends timeless character with modern luxury. This fully renovated 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom two story residence is designed for effortless living with a bright open layout and abundant natural light. The main level features newly refinished wide plank flooring throughout and a chef's eat-in-kitchen with marble countertops and a double oven, leading into a cozy family room featuring a large flat screen TV. Step directly outside onto a fully enclosed private flagstone patio, the ultimate low-maintenance outdoor oasis. A separate dining room and a formal living room anchored by a wood burning fireplace, offer the perfect backdrop for entertaining guests. Upstairs, the primary suite serves as a private sanctuary with a walk-in closet and an elegantly renovated bath accompanied by two additional bedrooms and a full bath. Nestled in a prime, in-town location, you are steps away from local boutiques, dining, parks, award winning library and train station for effortless commute. The unit also features wired fiber internet and a detached private garage. Up to 2 dogs are welcome! Enjoy all the space and privacy of a stand alone house with total condo convenience!
